findings.title: Controller check moved after panel is shown
findings.message: The controller check moved after makeKeyAndOrderFront, so on failure the panel has already been shown and the child window attached. finish:5 must clean this up; if it fails to do so the panel flashes or the responder chain is left modified.
findings.suggestion: Verify finish: removes the child window, restores the responder, and orders out the panel in this failure path.

findings.title: slices.Equal on handles and missing imports
findings.message: slices.Equal requires comparable elements. If ui.TrackHandle contains non-comparable fields (slices, funcs, or colors in a non-comparable struct), this will not compile. The diff also does not show imports of slices or image being added, so the file may not compile.
findings.suggestion: Confirm TrackHandle is comparable and that "slices" and "image" are imported in scalar_track.go; otherwise compare by a custom function.
